parameters.content:
## Failed-run alert
Set n8n env ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (Slack incoming webhook or any JSON POST).
On each CoreEngine workflow: Settings → Error workflow → select this workflow.
Do **not** toggle Active on this Error Trigger workflow itself.
n8n Executions (filter Error) remains the full history.
Repo JSON is source of truth — re-export after UI edits.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'CoreEngine n8n workflow failed: ' + ($json.workflow && $json.workflow.name), workflow: $json.workflow && $json.workflow.name, executionId: $json.execution && $json.execution.id, executionUrl: $json.execution && $json.execution.url, error: $json.execution && $json.execution.error && $json.execution.error.message }) }}

meta.crmNotes: n8n only fires an error workflow when the failing workflow points at it. Activate this workflow after ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is set. CoreEngine Setup → Connections / Tasks lists in-process failures, not n8n execution errors.
